clue.text: Tough nut is able to go to exercise class

parts.note: PE is physical education, the school exercise lesson
is able means can

explanation.surface: A hardy character manages to get to the gym class.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface hints at a stubborn person going to a gym session; 'to go to' here only means one piece follows the other.
explanation.definitionFit: The pecan is a hard-shelled nut from a hickory tree.

clue.text: Eat up quickly when the table looks dull

definitions.meaning: to finish food fast
the furniture's shine has gone, its gloss is gone

explanation.surface: Wolfing down a meal at a scruffy table.
explanation.definitionFit: To polish off is to consume quickly; a table with its polish off has lost its shine.

clue.text: Chirpy little creature, and game

definitions.meaning: a chirping insect
the bat-and-ball sport

explanation.surface: A happy small animal taking part in a sport.
explanation.definitionFit: The chirping insect shares its name with the English bat-and-ball sport played on a pitch.

clue.text: Recess fails to win approval

parts.note: no, as a refusal, fails to win
OK signals approval

explanation.surface: A parliamentary break fails to get the go-ahead.
explanation.definitionFit: A nook is a small alcove or corner.

clue.text: Avoid appearing mean in the pub

definitions.text: Avoid appearing mean in the pub

parts.words: Avoid appearing mean in the pub
parts.note: split as three words it is what a drinker does to avoid looking stingy, buying drinks for everyone; as one phrase it means to evade

explanation.surface: Advice on not looking tight-fisted in the local.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Avoid' alone is also the plain definition; the rest suggests buying a round of drinks for the table.
explanation.definitionFit: To get around a problem is to circumvent or dodge it.

clue.text: A translator? It's difficult to say!

definitions.meaning: playfully, someone who twists one language into another
a phrase hard to pronounce

explanation.surface: Musing over whether an interpreter is hard to pronounce.
explanation.definitionFit: A tongue twister is a phrase hard to articulate; a translator turns one language into another.

clue.text: Pity she married Boaz

definitions.meaning: an old word for compassion
the Moabite widow of the Old Testament book who married Boaz

explanation.surface: Regret that a woman wed Boaz.
explanation.definitionFit: Ruth means compassion, and the biblical heroine became the wife of Boaz.

clue.text: Fashionable rum in a cocktail goes like a bomb!

parts.note: U means upper-class, hence fashionable

indicators.note: a cocktail is a mixture, so the letters are mixed

explanation.surface: Trendy rum served in a mixed drink packs an explosive punch.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cocktail' scrambles RUM IN A to RANIUM.
explanation.definitionFit: This radioactive element is the fuel of atomic weapons.

clue.text: Bowler hat a British Prime Minister

definitions.meaning: the American name for a round hard felt hat
the Earl who was Prime Minister three times in Victoria's reign

explanation.surface: A Prime Minister wearing his bowler.
explanation.definitionFit: A derby is a bowler hat in America, and the 14th Earl of Derby led three governments.

clue.text: Help in a thug rendered unconscious

indicators.note: in places the word for help inside the word for thug

parts.note: a lout is a rough, uncouth thug
help means aid

explanation.surface: Someone goes to assist a hooligan who has been knocked out.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone laid out has been knocked flat and senseless.

clue.text: Unconventional partnership for a Test Match

definitions.meaning: a couple living together on approval before deciding to wed
test means trial and match means marriage

explanation.surface: A cricket Test described as an unusual batting partnership.
explanation.walkthrough: A Test Match is an international cricket game; 'partnership' also suggests a batting stand.
explanation.definitionFit: A couple cohabiting experimentally is having a trial union; trial is test and marriage is match.

clue.text: Unjust description of a blonde

parts.note: calling a blonde dark-complexioned would be unfair, since blondes are light-haired; the phrase for that also means unjust

explanation.surface: Complaining that a fair-haired woman has been wrongly characterised.
explanation.definitionFit: Something unjust is inequitable, the opposite of even-handed.

clue.text: Buys a keg containing alcoholic liquor

indicators.note: the words Buys a keg hold the answer within their letters

explanation.surface: Someone purchases a barrel full of drink.
explanation.definitionFit: Sake is Japanese rice wine, an alcoholic drink.

clue.text: Intoxicated by being in the limelight

definitions.meaning: slang for drunk
literally illuminated, as by a spotlight

explanation.surface: A drunk performer basking under the stage lights.
explanation.definitionFit: Lit up is slang for tipsy, and also describes something illuminated by lights.

clue.text: Very little escapes his notice at Lonrho

definitions.text: Very little escapes his notice at Lonrho

parts.words: Very little escapes his notice at Lonrho
parts.note: Very little reads as a synonym, and also as the nickname of Lonrho's boss, ... Rowland, said to miss nothing

explanation.surface: A remark about an all-seeing chief at the trading company Lonrho.
explanation.walkthrough: Lonrho was a British conglomerate run for decades by Roland 'Tiny' Rowland.
explanation.definitionFit: Tiny means minute or very small, and was also Rowland's nickname.

clue.text: Succeed in the first rule of horsemanship

definitions.meaning: to prosper
the first thing a rider must do is mount

explanation.surface: A riding instructor's opening advice about success.
explanation.definitionFit: To get on is to prosper, and also to climb onto a horse.

clue.text: Tied in the long jump

definitions.meaning: ... means fastened
a ... is a leap

explanation.surface: Two athletes finishing level in an event.
explanation.definitionFit: Bound means tied up, and a bound is a leap like those of a jumper.

clue.text: Where people go to train as speakers?

definitions.text: Where people go to train as speakers?

parts.words: Where people go to train as speakers?
parts.note: read as station passengers, they wait by the track to catch a train; read as orators, they stand on a raised stage

explanation.surface: A question about a school for public speaking.
explanation.walkthrough: 'train' looks like a verb for practising but also suggests the railway.
explanation.definitionFit: Speakers address a meeting from a raised stage, and rail passengers wait at a station's raised edge.

clue.text: Unconditional contract for a wind quartet maybe

definitions.meaning: with no conditions attached

definitions.text: contract for a wind quartet maybe
definitions.meaning: a woodwind group has no violin players

explanation.surface: An agreement for four woodwind players with no strings attached.
explanation.definitionFit: No strings means no conditions; a wind ensemble literally lacks string players.

clue.text: Monroe supporters say NATO's oil is its undoing

indicators.note: undoing suggests the words are taken apart and reassembled differently

explanation.surface: Followers of Monroe claim the alliance's oil will be its ruin.
explanation.walkthrough: President Monroe's doctrine kept America out of European affairs, so his supporters favoured staying apart from foreign entanglements. 'say' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Monroe's doctrine stood for American non-involvement abroad, a policy of staying aloof.

clue.text: Press to get difficulties resolved

definitions.meaning: to smooth clothes with a heated tool
to sort out problems

explanation.surface: Media pressure to settle problems.
explanation.definitionFit: To iron out is to press creases flat, and figuratively to smooth away problems.

clue.text: Locum requires a good bit of understanding

indicators.note: a good bit of means a large portion of the word understanding is taken

explanation.surface: A temporary doctor needs plenty of sympathy.
explanation.definitionFit: A locum is a substitute doctor or cleric filling in temporarily.

clue.text: Run a collective farm

definitions.meaning: a run is an enclosure for hens
a ... is a cooperative enterprise

explanation.surface: Instructions to manage a communal smallholding.
explanation.definitionFit: A coop is a hen enclosure, and a co-op is a cooperative business.

clue.text: Couple of high-ranking officers need a drink

indicators.note: couple of tells us to take the officer abbreviation twice

parts.note: CO is a Commanding Officer

explanation.surface: Two senior officers need a drink.
explanation.definitionFit: Cocoa is a hot chocolate beverage.

clue.text: The two of them include recipe for soup

indicators.note: include puts the abbreviation inside the word for the pair

parts.note: both means the two of them
R is the abbreviation for recipe, from Latin recipe on prescriptions

explanation.surface: A pair of cooks add a recipe for soup.
explanation.definitionFit: Broth is a thin soup made from stock.

clue.text: Soft melody for a loving couple

parts.note: P is piano, soft in music
an air is a tune

explanation.surface: A gentle tune played for two lovers.
explanation.definitionFit: Two people together form a twosome.

clue.text: Lean cad

definitions.meaning: to tilt, as a ship ... over
a scoundrel

explanation.surface: A thin scoundrel.
explanation.definitionFit: A ship heels when it tilts, and a heel is a rotter.

clue.text: French friends thought of "Lucky Jim"

definitions.meaning: the French word for friends
Kingsley ..., who conceived the comic novel

explanation.surface: French friends dreamed up a famous novel.
explanation.definitionFit: Amis is French for friends, and the novelist Kingsley Amis wrote the 1954 comedy.

clue.text: Ill humour leads to a serious complaint

parts.note: choler is anger, from the old humour of yellow bile

explanation.surface: Bad temper results in a grave grievance.
explanation.walkthrough: 'leads to' joins the pieces; 'complaint' means illness, not grumble.
explanation.definitionFit: This is a dangerous bacterial disease, and complaint is an old word for illness.

clue.text: Fast way to butt a judo expert

parts.note: to butt is to ram, as a goat does
a dan is a black-belt grade in judo, and so an expert

explanation.surface: Describing a quick method of headbutting a martial artist.
explanation.definitionFit: Ramadan is the Muslim month of fasting from dawn to dusk.

clue.text: Big guns make a hearty leader sick at heart

indicators.note: at heart places the word for sick in the middle of the blood vessel

parts.note: an artery leads blood away from the heart
sick means ill

explanation.surface: Heavy weaponry can make a cheerful commander feel nauseous deep down.
explanation.definitionFit: Artillery means large-calibre guns such as cannon.

clue.text: Possible seat of nasal infection for evil American

parts.note: sin is wickedness
US is the abbreviation for the United States, hence American

explanation.surface: Wickedness in America blamed for a blocked nose.
explanation.definitionFit: Sinuses are cavities around the nose where infection often settles.
